info.title: LivePanel API v2
info.summary: Everything the LivePanel web interface does, for programs.
info.description:
Works only on panels with the **Premium** plan; other plans answer `402 upgrade_required`.

Authenticate with an API token from System → API tokens: `Authorization: Bearer lp_…`. A token acts as its account (role and permissions are enforced as in the browser) and only within its scopes.

Request bodies are JSON (up to 16 KB) and unknown fields are rejected. Errors are `{"error": "code"}`. Paths of files are relative to the site user’s home folder (site files: `www/<domain>/…`).

Human documentation: https://wiki.livepanel.uz/en/api-reference
